workarounds.symptom: [GHSA-pjwx-r37v-7724] LangChain vulnerable to unsafe deserialization of attacker-controlled objects through overly broad `load()` allowlists (Affects langchain-core < 1.3.3)
workarounds.workaround: Upgrade langchain-core to patched release >= 1.3.3: pip install --upgrade 'langchain-core>=1.3.3' (Advisory: GHSA-pjwx-r37v-7724)

workarounds.symptom: [GHSA-926x-3r5x-gfhw] LangChain has incomplete f-string validation in prompt templates (Affects langchain-core < 1.2.28)
workarounds.workaround: Upgrade langchain-core to patched release >= 1.2.28: pip install --upgrade 'langchain-core>=1.2.28' (Advisory: GHSA-926x-3r5x-gfhw)
